stories.title: Microsoft outage shakes up companies, schools and local governments across US
summary: Local officials warn some services remain unavailable even as Outlook starts to resume normal operations after outageMicrosoft outage – live updatesThe Microsoft Outlook outage has shaken up companies and local governments across the US that use its suite of email, calendar, video conferencing and cloud storage systems.Even as Outlook started to resume normal operations Friday morning, local leaders from across the country, including in Miami, Maryland and Los Angeles, warned residents that certain staff or services were still unavailable due to the outage that started around 1pm ET on Thursday.

stories.title: Global oil supply returns to surplus for first time since start of Iran war, says IEA
summary: Supplies outstripped demand by almost 2m barrels a day in October as market shows ‘tentative signs of rebalancing’The world’s oil supply is swinging back to a surplus for the first time since the start of the US-Israeli war against Iran, the International Energy Agency (IEA) has said.Oil supplies outstripped demand by almost 2m barrels a day in October, the Paris-based agency said, as “Gulf exports recovered much faster than global oil demand”.
